lines.en: I walk forward on blue fire.
The bow taps softly against my back.
My feet land with almost no sound.
No arrows in my quiver, only light.
I follow the wall looking for a firing spot.
I test the string as I walk.
Wind leans left; I shift right.

lines.zh: 我的影子先一步爬上屋顶。
lines.en: My shadow climbs the roof first.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在自己影子上。
lines.en: Each step lands on my own shadow.
My hem brushes the grass without bending it.
I skip the front gate and take the side hall.

lines.zh: 我数着距离，找最好的角度。
lines.en: I count paces for the best angle.
I wipe the bow's back with my sleeve.
The empty string sounds once, softly.
I fix my eyes on a distant point.
I do not need to count my breaths.

lines.zh: 我把一支光箭在指间转。
lines.en: I spin a light arrow between my fingers.
Under the eaves it is quieter.
I wait for a shadow to appear.
A speck of blue light gathers on the string.
I test how far the string draws.
The wind stirs my hood.
You are standing in the open.

lines.zh: 我量了量你到墙的距离。
lines.en: I measure the distance from you to the wall.
Your head keeps moving; hard to aim.
I see the gap in your shield.
You look at me; I do not blink.
Your breathing is wilder than a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找最薄的地方。
lines.en: I look for the thinnest part of you.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我换个角度。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I change angle.
You should not stand in the light.
I tilt my head and calculate your next step.
My quiver got knocked crooked.
I grit my teeth and draw again.

lines.zh: 这一箭擦掉了我的兜帽。
lines.en: That shot tore off my hood.
I give half a step, stance intact.
Pain does not affect my aim.
You struck my bow.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼肩上的口子。
lines.en: I glance at the gash on my shoulder.
Do not think I only shoot from afar.
My hand shook once, then steadied.
Still standing, I can shoot again.
Food for your life? Not worth it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只缺一个目标。
lines.en: I am not hungry, only short a target.
Bread will not stop an arrow.
Put the food down and step back.
My belly has been empty for ages.

lines.zh: 我看了看你的手，不是食物。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not the food.
Put it away; do not distract me.

lines.zh: 这点香味飘不到我这儿。
lines.en: That smell does not reach me.
I shake my head and draw the string.
Keep it for the road.
My crossbow's crooked — lifting it again.
Not this close; the bow cannot open.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀擦过，都是冷的。
lines.en: Our shoulders brushed, both cold.
I turn and give half a step.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲撞响了我的箭袋。
lines.en: Your armor clinked against my quiver.
One bump and the string slackened.
I push back with an elbow.
Too close makes the shot harder.
I retreat to the wall and reset.
You are blocking my line of fire.
A shooter needs no companion.
My arrows are more reliable than people.
Do not stand beside me; you get in the way.

lines.zh: 我已经把自己许给了这场仗。
lines.en: I gave myself to this fight.

lines.zh: 谈这些做什么，目标还在动。
lines.en: Why talk of this? The target is moving.
I guard this stretch of wall alone.
Handing me arrows is enough.
A dead man's vows do not count.

lines.zh: 我的位置在屋顶，不在火边。
lines.en: My place is the roof, not the hearth.
I look down and check my fletching.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的一支断箭。
lines.en: I pick up a broken arrow.
This stone can prop my bow.

lines.zh: 我收了别人落下的箭羽。
lines.en: I collect the fallen fletching.
I do not pick up useless things.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚箭头，试了试锋。
lines.en: I pick up an arrowhead and test its edge.
A strip of cloth will wrap the grip.

lines.zh: 我把箭袋挪到顺手的位置。
lines.en: I shift the quiver to a handier spot.
This stick is too soft.
I pick up a dropped string.
I take only what I can use.
You stepped into my line of fire.
I have no time to warn you.
It is the one in iron.
I saw you through a gap in the tiles.
Target confirmed, range good.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经瞄好了。
lines.en: When you looked up, I was already aiming.

lines.zh: 你的影子比你先到墙下。
lines.en: Your shadow reached the wall before you.
I draw the string to my ear.
Do not move; it will not help.
I have been looking for you a while.
The iron on you is too bright.
I have your knee in my sights.
There, that is the angle.
I let out half a breath and steady my hand.

lines.zh: 你走进巷口，我的箭已经搭上。
lines.en: You step into the alley; my arrow is already nocked.
The string tightens; blue light flares.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的步子移准星。
lines.en: I slide the sight along your steps.

lines.zh: 风把你的衣角吹起来了。
lines.en: The wind lifts your hem.
I wait for you to take that step.
Your shield rises; I aim low.
The arrowhead points at your throat.
At this range, little math is needed.
I hold my breath; my hand is steady.
If you hear the string, it is too late.
Blue fire climbs the shaft.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路也算了进去。
lines.en: I factored in your escape route.
An inch off; let me adjust.

lines.zh: 别怨我，是你走进射界的。
lines.en: Do not resent me; you entered my line.
I release, and the string whispers.

lines.zh: 我半跪下来，这个角度更准。
lines.en: I kneel halfway; the angle is truer.

lines.zh: 你躲在墙角，我射那块砖。
lines.en: Hiding at the corner only gets the brick shot.

lines.zh: 蓝光沿着弦爬，你该弯下腰。
lines.en: Blue light creeps along the string; you should duck.

lines.zh: 我故意慢一息，等你自己撞上。
lines.en: I wait one breath on purpose, for you to walk into it.
I strike your wrist with the bow's back.
An arrow shaft works as a club.
You close in; I switch to a short blade.
That blow knocked your sword aside.
I elbow you in the ribs.
Do not block my bow.
I kick your knee.
The bowstring catches your hand.
I step back and strike again.
The arrowhead scrapes your armor.
You should not have come so close.

lines.zh: 我用箭袋挡下了你的刀。
lines.en: I block your blade with my quiver.

lines.zh: 这一下不为杀，只为推开。
lines.en: Not to kill, just to push away.
I step on your foot.
I jab the corner of my bow at your chin.

lines.zh: 你抢我的弓，那就一起摔。
lines.en: Grab my bow and we both go down.

lines.zh: 蓝火在墙头聚成一个人形。
lines.en: Blue fire gathers into a shape on the wall.
I open my eyes and look for high ground.
The bow is already in my hand.
I take the roof; the wind is strong.
Soul restored, quiver still here.
I draw the string to hear its sound.
This village has many good spots.
I sit up out of the rubble.
Cold hands, familiar bow.
The master is below; I am above.
I check windows, then the street.
Someone comes; I crouch low.
Fire burns my hood, almost warm.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶摔下来，弓没撒手。
lines.en: I fell from the roof, bow still held.
Water fills my quiver; the blue fire sinks.
The blast throws me off the wall.
Your arrow goes through my shoulder.
Magic seals my bowstring.
I quit eating a long time ago.
Thunder bursts beside my ear.
The void is pulling at my soul.
